questions: Do you have a known history of thyroid disease, such as Graves' disease?
Is the swelling and redness around your right eye (the one on the left side of the screen) significantly worse than the left?
Have you recently had any trauma to your face or eyes?
Are you currently experiencing double vision?
Does moving your eyes cause pain?
Have you noticed any recent changes in your vision, such as blurriness or loss of sight?
Do you have a fever or feel generally unwell?
orders: Measure intraocular pressure in both eyes
Assess for relative afferent pupillary defect (RAPD) using the swinging flashlight test
Perform fundoscopy to evaluate the optic disc and retina
Order serum thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), free T4, and TSI/TRAb antibodies
Obtain a CT scan of the orbits with contrast
